**Formal Welcome Speech:**

Good morning, ladies and gentlemen,

It is both an honor and a privilege to extend a warm welcome to all of you on this significant occasion. We are especially delighted to welcome Mr. Roget Warren, the Chief Administrative Officer of the Human Resources Department at Acme Internationals, New Jersey.

Mr. Warren is a highly respected leader in the field of human resources, with over twenty years of exemplary service in organizational development, employee relations, and strategic workforce planning. His contributions have been instrumental in transforming HR practices across international branches of Acme Internationals.

We are indeed fortunate to have him with us today at our company headquarters in Hyderabad, where he will deliver an extension lecture on *“Building Stronger Teams and Smarter Workplaces.”* His insights, drawn from a wealth of global experience, promise to offer valuable perspectives on creating resilient, high-performing teams in an ever-evolving corporate environment.

Mr. Warren, we are sincerely grateful for your presence and look forward to benefiting from your expertise.

On behalf of the entire team, I extend a heartfelt welcome to you.

Thank you.
